spec:
Add a reproducible fixture that runs a synthetic goal through the shipped default graph (and the lens-review graph from #499) and records CLI invocations, git fetch/push count, GitHub API calls, wall time and task-card/prompt bytes per node, via prompt_stats.py where it applies. Report the cost of a correction cycle (one finding reopening a node) and of a clean restack carry-forward against a no-correction baseline. Acceptance: the fixture runs in CI with noise-tolerant bounds on redundant invocations and repeated payload bytes, not wall-clock thresholds, and a short report can be quoted in the whitepaper. Dropped versus the old wording: the old-engine children (#481/#492/#494/#484), heartbeat and self-upgrade journeys, and lease/provider-idempotency re-proofs that the engine's unit tests already cover.

Migrated from GitHub issue #510 after the engine reset (#740).
title: Measure coordination overhead of the Git-native engine per goal
